control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of TK-8311

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on TK-8311 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. TK-8311 (reagent storage tanks) is in service for bulk reagent storage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 9 January 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on TK-8311 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during transfer operations; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
